note: Ours, read by make-events.js (docs/notes/events.md). evStage = evStageBase + r, stage = stageBase + n (server/event_ids.json, append-only). serve: census ids (the April 2019 pilot, Events Part 1) and types (GEM, Part 2) that are built, the rest is notSelected (an old onlyCensusIds list still works; no serve and no list builds every record). reasonText: the catalogue text of every reason a record or quest is not built. labelPhrases: the reconstruction notes of the event quest records -> label id; reconstructedWhy: the text of every label (shown in the Event Catalog, declared in the Notices). eventType: the value served when the donor value is not in servedEventTypes (3 = plain quest list; never 2 = raid mode with Raid Boards). boardEventType (1 = board mode with the Event Boards button, Part 3): served only on an entry with a board set handed out (KHUX_EVENT_BOARDS, make-events.js); without one a donor 1 is served as eventType. catalogEvStage: the Event Catalog banner (evStageBase + 0, never a record: records are numbered from 1), holding catalogStage (the Training Grounds of the Special Catalog), Details -> catalogUrl.

reasonText.shared: This notice shares its quests with another row of the catalogue: they are built once, under the other row.
reasonText.board: In the original this event had no quests of its own: it was played on the event boards. Where its boards are served they are listed on this page; otherwise they come with a later update.
reasonText.coin: In the original this event had no quests of its own: it paid Event Coins for the event boards. Where its boards are served they are listed on this page; otherwise they come with a later update.
reasonText.undated: The original start date of this event is not known, so it cannot be placed in the calendar and is not listed.
reasonText.wikiEmpty: The khuxwiki page of this quest gives no map or no enemy we can identify, so it cannot be rebuilt yet.
reasonText.rewardItemMissing: A reward of this quest (a medal or a material) does not exist in our game data yet, so the quest is not served.
reasonText.notSelected: Not part of the events served so far.
reasonText.enemyMissing: An enemy of this quest is not in our game data yet (its model has to be found first), so the quest is not served: enemies are never replaced by another one.
reasonText.mapUnusable: The original map of this quest cannot be used yet (a file or a room is missing), so the quest is not served.
reasonText.mapKeyUsed: The map of this quest is already used by another quest of the events, so it cannot be built a second time.
reasonText.rewardRowsMissing: The reward rows of the enemies or chests on the map of this quest are not known yet, so the quest is not served.
reasonText.raidSpecial: This quest is a raid or Special stage, served by its own generator.
reasonText.worldMismatch: The original map of this quest lies in another world than the quest itself, so it is held back until it is checked.

reconstructedWhy.donorKept: The quest keeps the values of the later game data; the khuxwiki page describes an earlier run of the same quest (2018), so it was not used for this one.
reconstructedWhy.wikiLowConfidence: One value of this quest comes from the khuxwiki page and could not be confirmed by a second source.
reconstructedWhy.mapIncomplete: The map file of this quest is incomplete in the data we have: the missing parts are reported, never invented.
reconstructedWhy.noWikiPage: No khuxwiki page exists for this quest: its values come from the later game data only, without a second source.
reconstructedWhy.wikiQuest: Quest rebuilt from the khuxwiki page: no master row of the original is known
reconstructedWhy.laterRun: The stage row and the map file of this quest are those of the same weekly quest in a later run (the row of this run is not in the data we have). Enemies, level, gem and rewards were checked against the khuxwiki page of this run; the AP, the gem and the world follow the page.
reconstructedWhy.wholeDay: In the original this event was open for a short window (minutes to hours); here it is open for its whole original day.
reconstructedWhy.dramaOff: The original scenes before or after this quest are not shown yet.
reconstructedWhy.eventCoins: The Event Coin rewards of this event are paid into the balance of its event boards: one balance per board set, shared by the events of the set, and the coins never expire.
reconstructedWhy.boardsLater: The event boards of this event are not served yet: in the original every cell of a board paid a reward for its Event Coins, and every board of this set has a cell (or a board reward) that does not exist here yet, mostly a Booster. The boards come back whole in a later update, with the Boosters; until then its quests are served as a plain list, and the Event Coins they pay are kept in the balance of the set (they never expire) for when its boards are served.
reconstructedWhy.noCoinSource: The event boards of this event are not handed out yet: none of the quests that paid their Event Coins can be served yet, so the boards could not be filled.
reconstructedWhy.wikiAp: AP from the khuxwiki page of this run: the surviving game data (a later snapshot) gives another AP.
reconstructedWhy.wwEnemy: Map enemy changed to the WW enemy (khuxwiki): the Japanese map file of this quest places a different enemy than the worldwide quest had, so that one enemy was replaced by the worldwide one (same place, count, level and drops).

roomWorldsNote: make-events.js (Task 5 Step 2, fix round 1): the rooms of an imported event map must be of the quest's world: roomWorlds = world of a room prefix (as gen_tours_v2.py WIDX; a prefix missing here counts as another world). neutralRooms {prefix: home world}: DG (Corridor of Darkness DG_0200, arenas DG_0100) fits world 1 Daybreak Town, where the original quests stand on DG rooms alone, or any world when the map also has a room of the quest's world (the Beast's Castle quiz quests). worldExceptions {map key: why}: maps checked by hand, the quest keeps the donor world. Else the quest is worldMismatch.
